This is because the person with this name is always absorbed in some form of work, study, or religious practices. It shows a strong work ethic and a desire to continually improve oneself and contribute to their community.

The person carries the name of the One who never rests, and it serves to inspire them to strive for excellence in their deen (faith), their day-to-day life, and in their relationships. It is a call to be consistent in their worship, to be ever-mindful of Allah's presence, and to serve as instruments of His Will. It also encourages them to emulate the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) who was the embodiment of busy in servitude to Allah.
